# `silk/schema/wire`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

One reader type shared by the schema formats.

## When to use
Use `WireReader` when code that reads a `Schema` type picks its format at run time.
`SchemaJson`, `SchemaToml`, `SchemaYaml` and `SchemaMsgpack` already read through it.

## Details
Each derived `Schema.read` compiles once for the shared reader. Its operations forward to the
concrete reader held by the union, which supplies the format's values and error reports.

Import as `WireReader` with `import silk.schema.wire { WireReader }`.

Public declarations: 1.
